name: Ursolan
summary: In western Azshara, Ursolan shelters the Timbermaw furbolgs east of Timbermaw Hold. Its ravine cuts through a stronghold named for the bear Ancient Ursol, where uncorrupted furbolgs defend their ground.

sections.title: Bastion of the Bear
sections.body:
Across a deep ravine in western Azshara, Ursolan climbs both rims. The Timbermaw hold this eastern branch of their territory. Through Timbermaw Hold, it links to Bear's Head in the south.

The camp takes its name from the bear Ancient Ursol. Here, furbolgs who have resisted the demonic corruption consuming many of their kin across Kalimdor have found a haven. They guard their borders against outsiders, including researchers from the night elven camp of Talrendis.

faq.answer: The Timbermaw furbolgs live in Ursolan. Their tribe is among the few in Kalimdor to resist demonic corruption.

faq.q: Why is this area called Ursolan?
faq.answer: Ursolan honors Ursol, one of the twin bear demigods the furbolgs revere.

faq.q: What is the deep gorge running through the camp?
faq.answer: A deep ravine cuts through Ursolan. Talrendis biologists from the nearby night elven camp often conduct field studies there.

faq.q: How does Ursolan connect to the rest of the Timbermaw territory?
aliases: how to get to timbermaw hold from ursolan
faq.answer: Ursolan lies just east of the Azshara entrance to Timbermaw Hold. Mountain tunnels link the Timbermaw's northern presence to Bear's Head in the south.

angles.text: As a druid, you can recognize how Ursolan's people revere the twin bear Ancients, Ursol and Ursoc. Both are central to nature worship and mastery of bear form.
As a night elf, you revere the bear Ancients, yet tensions mark this ground. Talrendis researchers study the ravine under the furbolgs' wary eyes.
